about: A footer kept on the last row by a scroll region while output streams above it into a full history, so the buffer rotates under fixed coordinates: one line, five, a whole region (the footer then the only row of the last read still in place), a hundred, a blank region and five lines below it, and the region full of one repeated line and five more of it. Every coordinate a reader can ask for (the kept start, the document's length, the caret) stays where it was; only the text under them moves.
